texto_aprovado: What they don't share is an address. Take one of them, the eastern brown snake. According to the Queensland Museum, it's found over most of Queensland, New South Wales and Victoria. It turns up in every habitat except rainforest, and it has adapted well to farmed, grazed and semi-urban land. Put simply, it does well where people farm and build.
